description:
Full record for one listed app by slug.
Use when: you have a slug from search_apps, latest_apps or get_vibe50 and need its source, website, builder, stack, stated revenue or evidence tier.
Do not use for: discovering apps (search_apps).
Returns: the app record, including evidence_tier, evidence_basis, evidence_checked_at and link; or isError code not_found.
Limits: Only live listings are returned.
Example: {"slug":"stella"}
name: get_app
title: Get one app
